name: talking
prompt:
Create a high-quality photographic overhead character asset for architectural projection mapping. Output one square image containing four DIFFERENT fully clothed high-school-age students, one per equal quadrant. Exactly vertical 90-degree orthographic TOP DOWN: tops of heads and shoulders visible, no faces looking at camera, no isometric tilt. Natural foreshortening and realistic proportions. Reference image is ONLY for camera angle, scale arrangement and diffuse lighting; create the requested new poses and new clothing.
Centers at (25%,25%), (75%,25%), (25%,75%), (75%,75%). Keep heads at each quadrant center, full silhouettes within each quadrant's central 75%, generous separation. Photographic hair and cotton/clothing texture, varied skin tones and hairstyles. Soft neutral unchanging light. Pure uniform MAGENTA #FF00FF background to key out in Blender. No checkerboard, grid, floor, scenery, labels, shadows or extra people. Each quadrant is ONE reusable person pose, all at the same real-world scale. Clothing modest and appropriate for school, no readable logos.
POSE SET: four STANDING CONVERSATION gestures, feet comfortably close, all bodies facing TOP. Upper-left: dark-skinned teen with short curls, cream sweater and blue jeans, pointing forward with right hand as if explaining a project. Upper-right: brown-haired teen with short haircut, burgundy sweatshirt and charcoal trousers, open left-hand conversational gesture. Lower-left: teen with a dark braid, denim overshirt, tan trousers, holding a small closed notebook to the chest, listening. Lower-right: teen with short red hair, sage green sweater and dark jeans, both hands loosely gesturing in front. These are relaxed stationary chatting poses, not walking or lunging. No table or chair.
